content.text:
The response due date is now set to 8 November 2026. I checked the draft against the RFx line data and vendor list, and both match: all ten quantities, delivery limits, storage zones and shelf-life minimums, plus vendors V01 to V05.

Vendors V04 (Lumen Peptide, Singapore, a trader) and V05 (Nilagiri Phytolabs) are new. V02 (Tungabhadra) is a distributor, so it will need to name the manufacturer for each line. The terms already require that.

Should I add a question to the questionnaire asking each vendor to confirm whether they are the manufacturer or a trader, and to name the manufacturing site for each line?
